subject: pol-p
title: PROJ.DY.------POL.P.
description: Chart on book p. 457 (TRF(CW)-29). The arrow points to POL-P, the second code of the title: POL-P (political policies) is the subject; PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics) is the partner. From the subject: CULT-SOLD (culture solidification), PER-DY (perception dynamics) and PROG-CONT (progressional continuance). From CULT-SOLD: DEF (definition). From DEF: PART (participation). From PROG-CONT: MT-INFO (multi-information) and BIA (bi-aitional). From BIA: AFI (affinity insight). The text above the chart speaks of "the seriousness of bi-aitionalism".
